page.metaDescription: Track eBay auctions, Buy It Now listings, and price drops with automated alerts. Catch sniping opportunities and new listings the moment they appear.
page.subtitle: Watch eBay auctions, Buy It Now items, and search results for price drops or new listings. Get alerts on a five-minute cadence.
page.intro: WebMonitor.fyi turns eBay product pages and search-result URLs into tracked monitors. The eBay tracker catches new listings matching a saved search, price drops on existing items, and auction state changes. Useful for collectors watching specific search terms, resellers tracking a category, and shoppers waiting for the right price on a specific item.

features.title: Saved-search monitoring
features.body: Paste an eBay search URL and get alerts whenever a new listing matches. Useful for collectors hunting specific items.

features.title: Auction state tracking
features.body: Watch current bid, time remaining, and bidder count on a specific auction. Set the criterion to alert when the price stays below your max with under N minutes left.

features.title: Buy It Now drop alerts
features.body: For fixed-price listings, monitor the BIN price for drops and notify when it crosses your target.

features.title: Cross-platform comparison
features.body: Compare an eBay listing's price to the same product on Amazon, Walmart, or Best Buy — all in one dashboard.

steps.title: Paste an eBay URL
steps.body: A specific listing page, or a search results URL with your filters applied.

steps.title: Write the criterion
steps.body: Examples: "Alert me when a new listing matches this search." "Notify me when this BIN price drops below $X." "Let me know if a watched auction goes under $Y."

steps.title: Pick a frequency
steps.body: Five-minute checks for active auctions in the final hours; hourly for saved searches.

steps.title: Receive alerts
steps.body: Email, SMS, or webhook — link straight to the listing.

useCases: Hunt for collectibles matching a specific search term
Monitor auction price during the closing window without manually refreshing
Catch new resale supply in a category you trade in
Watch a seller's store for new listings
Cross-check an eBay BIN against Amazon and Walmart pricing
page.limits: WebMonitor reads the public eBay page. Private listings, eBay best-offer negotiations, and seller-specific promotions visible only after login are outside scope. Bidding itself is not automated — WebMonitor alerts you; bids happen on eBay.

faq.q: Can I bid on auctions automatically?
faq.a: No. WebMonitor sends alerts so you can decide and act. For automated bidding, use eBay's own max-bid system. The two work together — WebMonitor catches the right window; you place the bid.

faq.q: Does the eBay tracker work for saved searches?
faq.a: Yes. Paste a search URL with filters applied. New listings matching the search trigger an alert.

faq.q: Can I track auction time remaining?
faq.a: Yes. Time remaining is one of the fields on the page that the monitor can watch. Combined with current bid, useful for tracking sniping windows.

faq.q: How fast can the eBay tracker check?
faq.a: Five-minute intervals on paid plans, hourly or daily on the free plan. For final-hour auction tracking, the five-minute interval is the right choice.
